content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends engaging in at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise per week or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity exercise per week. This physical activity should be distributed over a minimum of three days, ensuring that no more than two consecutive days are spent without activity. For individuals who are younger or have a higher level of physical fitness, shorter sessions of more intense activity, totaling at least 75 minutes per week, may also be appropriate.
